Each pulse grows outward with a pulsing red hue, leaving behind glowing trails that fade gradually. The system introduces occasional distortions—jagged ripples—that disrupt the smooth expansion before reforming into new patterns. The result is an organic, ever-changing field of geometric light, where persistence and motion interplay to create a sense of continuous transformation without any user interaction.
